minutes.headline: Sewer Commission set the start date for illegal sump pump fines, approved a flow assessment contract, and denied a grease trap waiver.
minutes.summary: The commission discussed adding two West Street properties to the Pratt Street sewer project. It reviewed the inflow and infiltration inspection results and decided when fines on known illegal sump pump connections would begin. It approved the flow assessment contract, denied a grease trap waiver, adopted regulation amendments, and discussed the new high school grease trap and its own role in reviewing it.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start; none was apparent.

Deny the waiver request from the church regarding its exterior grease trap
Accept the amendments to the regulations

budget_items.topic: Grease trap annual fee late charge
budget_items.what_was_said: Non-compliant establishments are at the late fee level, with larger fines to follow for missed reporting.
The business manager said the warrant had a second page and mentioned the year-end commitment amount.

budget_items.what_was_said: The last invoice covers all the work and report, leaving a small balance on the purchase order.

decisions.decision: For known illegal sump pump connections, no fine if corrected and re-inspection scheduled within the letter's period; otherwise the fine runs back to the original finding date. Applied to this case only, not made policy.
Send a letter to West Street area residents in the service zone and contact the two interested property owners.
Get Weston Sampson to re-inspect the two properties that requested it as soon as possible.
Fines for late grease trap reporting will run from the start of the current fiscal year; bills and letters to follow in weeks.
Chair to talk to the town engineer about options for the abandoned property with a suspected collapsed sewer.

what_happened.line: The commission set when fines begin for known illegal sump pump connections, for this case only and not as policy.
It voted to accept a new flow assessment contract, good for three years if renewed.
It voted to deny a church's request to waive its exterior grease trap requirement.
It voted to accept amendments to its sewer regulations.
Fines for late grease trap reporting will run from the start of the current fiscal year, with bills and letters to follow in weeks.

why_it_matters: Property owners with an illegal sump pump connection face a monthly penalty unless they fix it and schedule re-inspection within the period in the letter.

Food establishments that are late on grease trap reporting or annual fees can expect bills and larger fines, and owners joining the West Street sewer project may face connection costs, especially multi-family properties.
